children: David Jones turning insolvent has cost mall owner Scentre a bull. Morgan Stanley downgrades Scentre to equal-weight, from overweight, citing concerns that investors will lower earnings estimates on the uncertain outlook for one of its biggest tenants. "We think consensus is too high for Scentre," analyst Simon Chan, pointing to EPS forecasts of 25.1 Australian cents in 2027. It expects Scentre will be able to reuse any area vacated by David Jones. MS notes Scentre has a very strong record in dealing with department stores requiring less floor space. "However, until we get some certainty around the timing, and plans for any potential vacancy, the market may hold a conservative view on the stock," MS says. Its price target falls 9.9% to A$4.00/share. Scentre ended last week at A$3.61. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
